name: Recipe

suggests.drupal/rdf: Optional RDF mappings for the default Recipe fields (RDFa schema.org output).

project_description: Recipe is a module for sharing cooking recipes. It ships a `recipe` node bundle with fields for description, instructions, notes, source, prep/cook time and yield, plus a bundled `ingredient` submodule that defines an Ingredient content entity and a custom `ingredient` reference field type storing a quantity, a unit key and a note alongside each ingredient reference. Two pseudo-fields (total time, yield) are computed at view time, RDFa schema.org metadata is emitted when core RDF is present, and custom Views display/style plugins export recipes as RecipeML XML or wrapped plain text. Upgrade paths migrate 6.x and 7.x recipe data. NOTE: this culinary contrib module is unrelated to core's config-and-content "Recipes" system introduced in Drupal 10.3.
